name: mac-app-packaged-identity
goal: The packaged Harness.app reports isPackaged so the bundled Tracker self-install runs, and nothing in the bundle is group or world writable; a packaged-app test proves both

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Installed app (release 138w2r) runs Contents/MacOS/Electron: Electron app.isPackaged is false for an executable named electron, so initializeTrackerBundle returns early. Helpers/harness and the copied playwright-core are mode 0777.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: tracker-bundle.test and package-mac-tracker.test call installBundledTracker directly with a fake or partial bundle; nothing launched an assembled app, so the isPackaged guard and bundle modes were never exercised. New package-mac-app.test.ts assembles with the real packager and launches it.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red failed at 5b324589fb with: expected { isPackaged: false } to deeply equal { isPackaged: true }; the bundle-mode test also failed

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
